entries.note: An IPS scan by the sending post, abroad.
The sending post's dispatch, which it reported to HayPost as data.

entries.wording: Receive item at office of exchange (Inb)
entries.note: An IPS scan at the inward office of exchange; its country is where the item was sent.
Customs released the item into the post's network; it is not a return to the sender.
The office that hands the item over received it.

entries.wording: The notification was sent to the customer: Addressee not available; Scheduled for further action/processing today
entries.note: An IPS record of an item not delivered. The reason and what happens next come in the row's extra information, which the adapter adds after the event.
